# httrack / fuzz-sitemap

httrack's own fuzz target `fuzz-sitemap` ([source](source/fuzz-sitemap.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over httrack (xroche/httrack at 6e29ab3b).

hts_sitemap_scan over an exact-size heap copy with a URL cap from byte 0; the callback counts URLs but the count is never checked against the cap.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against httrack at commit 6e29ab3b.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch httrack` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz-sitemap.plain` | 689,904 | `e7a2757f071f4e59e45f98774c054d16b9a5fb5dc3b2a6bd2820df5c165d7329` |
| ubsan | `fuzz-sitemap.ubsan` | 690,672 | `6088ef85fcac4b718ac29332aae3c295096e0f3176dd859895469586df0f6afe` |
| asan | `fuzz-sitemap.asan` | 1,219,512 | `0e5047c7cafb2c988740bbf6d09116e4269d9bd8025e7d186ac2548e2a66d1b0` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz-sitemap.asan-ubsan` | 1,220,088 | `32917895cf86aba46eeaa48766f4527fce5652a98e8bcd4339231a5eacf4b3b8` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libbrotlicommon.a` (a library from the build image), `libbrotlidec.a` (a library from the build image), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)

- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libbrotlicommon.a` (a library from the build image), `libbrotlidec.a` (a library from the build image), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
